blocks.html: The USI Alumni Chapter Leads are the local contact (an alumnus/a) for all USI Alumni living and working in the same area, wishing to get together and stay in touch with USI. Chapter Leads are alumni leaders who are committed to supporting the University and connecting alumni with each other by volunteering time, energy and talent.
